//storage: Intentionally not wired up. Media goes to Cloudinary (SRS §7.1), so Firebase
Storage has never been provisioned on this project — and including the block
makes a plain `firebase deploy` fail with 'Storage has not been set up'.
storage.rules is still in the repo: if Storage is ever enabled, it starts
closed instead of wide open. To activate it, click Get Started in the
console, then move this key back to "storage": { "rules": "storage.rules" }.
